segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on and countdown, claims Case said he could win Olympics in crew meeting.

segments.title: Elon Musk vs EU, UK Unrest, Military Bases
segments.notes: Case covers Musk's Tropic Thunder meme response to EU DSA warning, Musk's UK civil war tweets and fake detainment camp article, debate over US military bases in UK (6 Air Force bases confirmed). Kendelle walks through at 20:59.

segments.title: Who Would Win Olympic Gold?
segments.notes: Munch claims he'd win any Olympic event through sheer excellence; Crum dismantles Munch's delusions citing his illiteracy and false reality. Munch declares himself the Olympics personified.

segments.title: Blazer Tailoring, Dry Mouth, Mouth Exercises, French Kissing, Fart Jar
segments.notes: Jeb and his father (trapped in wood) follow a blazer-making tutorial, then watch videos on dry mouth remedies, mouth strengthening exercises, French kissing techniques (cupcake demo), and a disturbing fart-in-a-jar tutorial featuring a doll named Dave. Jeb flags the fart channel as potentially predatory due to children's content and doll-sniffing.

segments.title: AI Chatbot Usage Report & Live Roleplay Test
segments.notes: Liliana joins desk to discuss Washington Post analysis of 200k WildChat conversations: 21% creative writing/roleplay, 18% homework, 15% work, 7% sexual. Case and Liliana test ChatGPT roleplay as Russian oligarch on Martha's Vineyard; Kendall reacts to Love Is Blind UK in background.

segments.title: JD Vance Drag Name Debate
segments.notes: Munch proposes 'Conserva Live'; Crum counters with 'Ashley's Furnipus' (Ashley's Furniture + couch sex + pussy pun). Chat suggests 'Couchina D'. Munch claims victory, announces run for office.

segments.title: Summer Penis Phenomenon
segments.notes: Chet triggers on 'science', tackles Crum through a wall (citing castle doctrine sign), then explains 'summer penis' — heat-induced vasodilation making flaccid penis appear larger — with Paul Wall musical accompaniment.

segments.title: Movie Trailers: Adam Sandler, Twilight of the Warriors, The Monkey, Moana 2
segments.notes: New correspondent Trent hosts trailer reactions: Adam Sandler stand-up special, Hong Kong walled city action film, Osgood Perkins' The Monkey (teeth in dark hole), Moana 2 (minions crossover). Case and Trent debate whether all kids movies are about death.

segments.title: Hellman's Mayonnaise Fragrance & Hype Train Finale
segments.notes: DJ Newsic and Hype Train close show: Hellman's partners with Will Levis on mayonnaise-based fragrance 'Mayonnaise Accord'; Hype Train delivers extended mayonnaise sexual freestyle over beats, promotes mayonnaise as lube. Pepito appears on roof demanding cheese.

characters.notes: hype train host. Derails into extended mayonnaise sexual freestyle; promotes mayonnaise as lube; acknowledges bits/subs.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers Elon Musk's EU feud and UK misinformation, then descends into Olympic delusion debates, a tailoring tutorial derailed by a predatory fart-jar channel, AI chatbot usage statistics, a JD Vance drag name contest won by 'Ashley's Furnipus', Chet tackling Crum through a wall to explain summer penis physiology, and a movie trailer block hosted by new correspondent Trent. The broadcast closes with DJ Newsic and Hype Train sexualizing Hellman's new mayonnaise fragrance while Pepito demands cheese on the roof.
